experiment: Xyce's noise .prn after an interrupt (the Xyce runner, 2026-10-16, phase 2; §14 q.26): a 2.7e6-point .NOISE (DEC 450000 from 1 Hz to 1 MHz) sent SIGTERM 4 s in
result: the .prn holds complete rows only (164,830 to 188,231 in the phase-2 runs), ends with a newline and has no `End of Xyce` line; rawfile.read_prn reads every row of it, and results.collect converts it `interrupted`
rules: §2.7 status 3 / §14 q.26: an interrupted Xyce noise run is converted from its .prn, whose rows Xyce writes whole (run_xyce; rawfile.read_prn takes a table without its End line)
